title: The card becomes the chart

members.role: the world plate holds and drifts its few pixels - the ground the prop is about to land on
the prop card is thrown in with a paper mass and lands one second before the scene ends
the world dips through black on the boundary frame, the landed card riding the veil
the ledger page grows out of that same card's rectangle - `snap_from` names the dock the viewer was just shown

does: The prop you were just handed IS the evidence page: a thrown card lands on the plate, the world dips, and the chart grows out of that card's own rectangle to fill the stage.
